Market intelligence reports indicate that iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have achieved strong sales in China, with Apple becoming the top-selling brand during the launch week.

Counterpoint Research stated that there are three reasons behind the popularity of Apple's latest iPhone...

Counterpoint Research's "China Weekly Smartphone Retail Tracker" report noted that since July this year, overall sales of new smartphones in China have dropped 17% year-over-year due to rising costs. However, the firm pointed out that this downturn has reversed with the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro.

Three reasons behind the success

Counterpoint analysts believe there are three reasons behind the strong popularity of the models.

First, the delayed launch of the base model iPhone 18. Since Apple released the two iPhone 18 Pro models earlier, launching later than the standard version, some consumers may have chosen to buy the higher-end versions rather than continue waiting.

Second, price increases across major high-end smartphones have made consumers more willing than before to pay higher prices. Apple absorbed some of the pressure from rising component costs itself, making the iPhone 18 Pro appear to offer better value for money.

Third, Counterpoint described it as "positive channel support," generally referring to vigorous promotion and marketing by retailers and carriers.
